observation: Calling external tool binaries via absolute host paths (e.g. /home/moellekenl/PhpstormProjects/agent-recall-compiler/bin/agent-recall-compiler) prevents task configurations from being portable across developer machines or containerized environments.

evidence.summary: By registering the path repository inside composer.json, vendor binaries are compiled into vendor/bin/agent-recall-compiler. Running the compile make target on host runs the symlinked tool successfully.

hypothesis: Registering local tools as composer path repositories under require-dev allows vendor/bin symlinks to be generated deterministically, enabling tool configuration to reference relative vendor paths instead of absolute host-dependent paths.
validated_conclusion: Add path repository configuration to composer.json for local tool integration, and invoke the tool binaries via standard vendor/bin/ paths in the Makefile to maintain workflow reproducibility and portability.
